states.label: Root degraded
states.sublabel: retain receipt; expose safe error code

cards.title: Discovery owns observation, not import
items: fsnotify events request a full scan; periodic reconciliation repairs missed hints.
Overlapping roots and hard links share a native source version and one queue handoff.
A linked item continues through the existing preparation and reviewed import lifecycle. Discovery never imports into the collection.
Native directory identity deduplicates aliases. An eligible existing registration path is retained; otherwise selection is deterministic.

A changed nonempty registration set is installed on a fresh backend and fully revalidated before publication. Publication requests an immediate full scan, closing the traversal-to-registration gap. An unchanged verified set does not request another immediate scan.

Source evidence: 05102c1cc0c4b1db00826dc007753b544162e79b; internal/intake/watch_events.go:23–140; internal/intake/watch_service.go:159–171,206–256,274–295. These ranges cover registration identity, complete successor installation and postvalidation, immediate follow-up scanning, and drain cancellation/join. Native-platform qualification is separate.

cards.title: Pause and restored suspension are separate controls
items: Queue Pause prevents automatic enqueue and preparation; observations may remain pending.
Portable restore or Undo consumes a native authority fence and suspends discovery, including restored absence.
Resume does not Activate restored watch authorization; ordinary configuration changes cannot implicitly Activate it.

cards.title: Crash recovery preserves the original request
items: The short state owner covers pending handoff, queue publication and final link, so a successful companion capture cannot split the pair.
Death between commits leaves a recoverable intent; provenance remains created, associated or unknown rather than claiming exactly once.
Renames may supply an authorized retained descriptor for the same native version. They never rewrite the queue source tuple, reset attempts or retry terminal items.

cards.title: Supplemental evidence scope
items: Supplemental source revisions: refusal-preserving Undo 494689f197e1afcaaae6ba1090159165b7953c1a; readable-audio admission 6d1b89aec69fef14dfbd76a43c890d5fa9ded0c4; cancellable collection reads 76d507cd514fc04c15bff17f69eba37bb3b591ce; watched-folder ownership 05102c1cc0c4b1db00826dc007753b544162e79b. Historical repository pins and cards retain their original scope. Source evidence does not establish renderer checks, whole-file audio integrity or native-platform qualification.

cards.title: Linked handoff view
items: The quiet native version continues to watch-handoff-lifecycle.html for authorization recheck, durable handoff, pending-intent recovery and the linked queue item. Quiet is the shared boundary state; this observation view retains every observation, pause, restored-suspension and degraded-root transition.
